note: A passing checker means every claim here is TRUE, not that the candidate is publishable. This record honestly reports nine blocked or proposed gates. Two of them — installed-APK-hash-verified and installed-resource-lineage-verified — carry complete, passing evidence and are held open only by the device-validated prerequisite; see docs/reports/PHASE_4_AURELIUS_RELEASE_READINESS.md for why that prerequisite was not relaxed.

architecture-approved.detail: Checkpoint B returned CHANGES REQUESTED; this candidate answers those corrections and is returned for re-review

assembled.detail: AAB and debug APK built and verified; build fails if verification fails

consumer-lineage-verified.detail: three roles enforced against COMMIT OBJECTS (blob/LFS oid), not the working tree; two clean detached-worktree rebuilds from the source commit are byte-identical and equal the canonical artifacts

device-validated.detail: a device session DID occur on 2026-07-26 (wireless adb, Watch7 SM-L310, API 36) and four rows PASS: install with upgrade continuity, installed-APK pullback, installed-resource lineage, and the permission A/B. The gate stays blocked because the Checkpoint B visual matrix was not run — AOD at actual scale, ten sleep/wake cycles, the date/reserve/hands/gears/cage/parallax rows, Command Satin legibility at actual scale, crash/ANR review and touch-inertness. No DEVICE_TEST_RESULTS.md exists for rc2, so this gate has no basis to close.

dex-gate-passed.detail: release dex allowlisted and deleted only after verification; every debug-APK dex classified — 6 generated R classes plus 4 named D8 desugaring stubs, 0 unexplained; AAB contains no dex

installed-APK-hash-verified.detail: EVIDENCE COMPLETE AND PASSING: the APK pulled back from /data/app on the Watch7 hashes byte-identical to the candidate, so the artifact on the panel is the artifact in the repository and not a re-signed or re-packaged variant. Held at `proposed` rather than `complete` solely because the gate model requires device-validated first, and the visual-matrix half of that gate has not been run. Nothing further is needed from the device for THIS row.

installed-resource-lineage-verified.detail: EVIDENCE COMPLETE AND PASSING: of the 60 inventory resources extracted from the INSTALLED APK, 58 are byte-identical to repository source and 0 drifted. The 2 non-identical entries are both explained and neither is drift — res/xml/watch_face_info.xml is compiled to binary AXML at packaging, and res/values/integers.xml is folded into resources.arsc. res/raw/watchface.xml, the file that defines every pixel of the face, is byte-identical. Held at `proposed` for the same prerequisite reason as installed-APK-hash-verified.

owner-pixel-approved.detail: APPROVAL-0005 owner.status is proposed. The craftsmanship DIRECTION was approved at Checkpoint A; final pixel acceptance requires the wear evidence the review made a condition.

owner-wear-complete.detail: zero wear sessions recorded. Requires AGENOR to wear the watch with rc2 installed and run tools/wear_log.py; cannot be invented.

permissions-verified.detail: SETTLED EMPIRICALLY on the Galaxy Watch7. The previously UNPROVEN half is now measured: rc2 declares no permission and still receives live heart rate. The balance wheel is driven at HR/60 Hz, so its frequency reads back the rate the runtime handed the face — 1.7300 Hz and 1.7350 Hz over two runs (103.8 and 104.1 bpm), against a documented 70.0 bpm fallback, matching the watch's own live reading to within 0.2 bpm. dumpsys shows the WFF runtime, not this package, holding the sensor connection; the face declares hasCode=false and could not open one. The package dump reports zero requested permissions, so nothing could have persisted across the in-place upgrade from the build that once declared BODY_SENSORS. android.permission.health.READ_HEART_RATE is deliberately NOT adopted; Variant B is retained unshipped for repeatability. The two outstanding HR recordings (post-exertion tracking, off-wrist fallback) are behavioural rows of device-validated, not permission questions, and are not claimed here.

policy-ready.detail: its permissions-verified prerequisite is now satisfied, so the declared-permission position for the listing is settled (none). Still blocked on owner-only inputs: the four TEST-1 account facts, a privacy policy actually hosted at https://x1c7.com/privacy/aurelius, and a chosen support email plus response commitment. Price remains a recorded recommendation, not the owner's decision.

publishable.detail: interlocked: every required predecessor must be complete first. All five are not — architecture-approved, policy-ready, signing-authorized, owner-pixel-approved and owner-wear-complete.

signing-authorized.detail: no production signing material exists and none is authorised (ADR-010 §5)
